Added a "Back" button at the bottom of the Create Love Mail page. It:

1. Uses Next.js router to navigate back to the previous page
2. Is styled to match the app (light green background, matching the header buttons)
3. Is positioned on the left, with "Export Data" remaining on the right

The button uses `router.back()` to go to the previous page in the browser history, which should work for navigation from other pages.
